Bulk Basket Customers.name: Bulk Basket Customers
Bulk Basket Customers.strategy: Fewer orders but very large baskets (18+ items per order). Offer bulk discounts, family pack thresholds and seasonal pantry stock-up promotions.
key_tactics: Pantry stock-up bundles & wholesale family box deals
Tiered order-level discount thresholds ($10 off $100+)
Automated replenishment reminders 15-20 days post-order
Cross-category discovery sampler packs
Bulk Basket Customers.persona_summary: Bi-weekly or monthly pantry stockers and families purchasing extensive groceries in single comprehensive trips.

Frequent Customers.name: Frequent Customers
Frequent Customers.strategy: Regular, habit-driven shoppers. Encourage larger baskets with cross-sell offers, recipe bundles and personalized multi-packs.
key_tactics: Basket size upsell nudges (e.g. 'Add 2 more items for free shipping')
Recipe-driven cross-selling (pairing Avocado with Limes & Garlic)
Mid-week scheduled reminder push notifications
Volume discounts on high-frequency fresh produce
Frequent Customers.persona_summary: Consistent weekly replenishment shoppers who have high intent but could expand their category breadth.

Highly Loyal Customers.name: Highly Loyal Customers
Highly Loyal Customers.strategy: Very frequent shoppers with the highest reorder rate. Protect them with loyalty rewards, early access, VIP perks and subscription tiers.
key_tactics: Exclusive VIP preview access to new organic items
Milestone-based cashback & free express delivery
Priority support & personalized basket subscriptions
Loyalty tier multiplier on weekend purchases
Highly Loyal Customers.persona_summary: Daily/weekly grocery shoppers who rely on the platform for their fresh kitchen staples with repeat purchase rates over 70%.

Occasional Customers.name: Occasional Customers
Occasional Customers.strategy: Low activity and the longest gap between orders. Run reactivation win-back campaigns, comeback coupons and surveys.
key_tactics: Aggressive comeback coupons ($15 off next order within 7 days)
Customer friction exit surveys to identify churn cause
Seasonal holiday flash sales and loss-leader offers
SMS reactivations highlighting new store additions
Occasional Customers.persona_summary: Infrequent one-off shoppers or lapse-risk customers with long intervals between minimal item purchases.

Regular Customers.name: Regular Customers
Regular Customers.strategy: Moderate activity with low reorder rate. Nudge them to reorder using smart reminders, personalized restock prompts and category discovery.
key_tactics: Re-engagement notifications when previous items run out
Category discovery discounts (e.g., 15% off Dairy & Bakery)
Curated 'Order Again' single-click checkout widget
Gamified loyalty points on 2nd and 3rd subsequent orders
Regular Customers.persona_summary: Customers with moderate trip frequency who frequently switch between channels and need consistent triggers.
